baseline: Eight-game exponentially weighted player-yardage mean with 0.85 per-game recency weight
challenger: Baseline multiplied by opponent yards-per-opportunity relative to league, shrunk with 300 league-average opportunities and capped to 0.85-1.15
leakageControl: Every forecast uses only rows from earlier completed weeks
selectionMetric: Mean absolute error; root mean squared error diagnostic
reason: The candidate improvement was below one percent for every market and reversed in at least one validation season. Matchup and game environment remain represented by the 75 percent power-de-vigged live market component rather than an unvalidated second adjustment.
